decision.observation: Thursday the 11th, 2:10 p.m.; the farmer is on the vertical cobblestone path beside the fountain square, with the route south open.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing south will reach the southern east–west town road, from which the river bridge and beach route can be tested before the Fish Shop closes.
decision.memory: Target: Fish Shop at the southeast beach; Willy's promised-item meeting remains unresolved. Funds are 218g. Stay on cobblestones and avoid the wooded southern exit and grass obstructions.
